description: Test file for the workload scheduling strategy in Kubernetes, including validation and update tests for workload objects.

methods.name: TestWorkloadStrategy
methods.description: Tests whether the workload strategy is namespace scoped and does not allow create on update.

methods.description: Creates a context with request info for scheduling.k8s.io API group and workloads resource.

methods.name: TestPodSchedulingStrategyCreate
